assumptions.statement: The team intends to open-source the Terraform code in the future while keeping implementation details (data) private.
assumptions.quote: We want to separate code from data, so in the future we can open source the code without disclosing our implementation details, maybe keeping the data in a private Github repository

assumptions.statement: The team prefers to manage secrets within the same repository and process as the Terraform code, rather than using a separate repository or tooling.
assumptions.quote: We want to be able to encrypt sensitive data in the repository: we want to support sensitive data encryption as part of the same process, without having to manage secrets in a different repository, with different scripts, etc.

assumptions.statement: The infrastructure is organized into distinct tiers or application stacks that require separation of resources, particularly between different GOV.UK applications.
assumptions.quote: We want to separate Terraform code into different projects, each one managing an infrastructure tier or application stack. This is especially important to separate resources between GOV.UK applications.
